title: 第18章 把一切都清理干净第19章 天下第一玄境
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
沉翔没有杀掉这些人，否则会惊动躲在别处的其他人。到时候整个陆家都会被惊动，这次他来这里的目的就是为了掏空他们的口袋。
他确信，陆家之所以能够加入魔道宗，是因为他们有很好的资源。与此同时，陆家也想学习魔功，以便变得更加强大。
魔功可以让人在短时间内快速提升实力，掌握更强的力量。不过，这是通过非常残酷的手段得到的，有些魔功需要喝人血、吃人心、肉等等。只有这样，才能被培养。一般来说，在这个修炼过程中，首当其冲的都是普通平民，所以魔道是不被大众所容忍的。
一旦陆家引以为豪的药材耗尽……或者‘丢失’，那么陆家就会被魔道宗抛弃。到时候，他们与魔道宗勾结的事情就会败露，不用沉翔亲自出手，整个陆家都会被灭亡。
沉翔潜伏在巨山周围的草丛中，终于在山脚下发现了数量较多的人。那里甚至还有两名真武境二重的武者。这些家族之中，真武境的武者并不多，但是，却有两个人驻扎在这里。显然，他们正在守护着什么重要的东西。
沉翔确认药草园的入口很近。
“如果是你之前遇到的那个药草园，陆家很可能根本就没有办法从真正的入口进入药草园！如果这是真正的入口，他们就不需要在这里驻扎这么多人。这个入口很可能是一个人造的入口，绕过了真正的入口。”
苏媚瑶说道。
沉翔点了点头，继续寻找真正的入口，因为钥匙还在他手里。虽然不确定是否有用，但尝试一下总没有坏处。
沉翔望向一个山洞，里面有一扇石门。附近以及山洞内，都有不少守卫。虽然实力不强，但每个人的警惕性都很高。
如果沉翔找不到真正的入口，他就只能从这个戒备森严的入口进去了。当他不得不出手的时候，必然会惊动陆家的其他人。
绕了半山之后，沉翔找到了一个守卫很少的地方。偶尔也只有一两个人在巡逻。
“应该就在这里吧！”
沉翔看着一个被许多巨石挡住的山洞。他立即走过去，用神念探查。
“里面有一扇该死的门！”
沉翔兴奋的说道，然后手掌轻轻拍在了一块巨石上。突然，那块巨石化为粉末，被风吹散。
这就是【化骨魔掌】。轻轻一按，那块坚硬的巨石就化成了极细的粉末。
沉翔继续接连拍出几掌。他在靠近地面的地方挖了一个洞，足够他爬进去。爬进去后，他用附近的杂草遮住了洞口，免得被巡逻的守卫发现。
沉翔来到了一个漆黑的山洞，在向山洞深处走去的时候，他取出了一块闪闪发亮的石头，照亮了周围的环境。很快，他就遇到了一扇铁门。
这给沉翔一种很熟悉的感觉，因为这和他之前发现的药草园是同一扇门。他拿出钥匙，插入铁门上的一个小口，随着他的转动，铁门渐渐打开，但缓慢只是因为沉翔用尽了所有的力量压住了铁门，以防止铁门被撞坏。门引起任何声音或剧烈振动。

随着铁门打开，沉翔看到的并不是想象中的药草园，而是出现在面前的一条通道，通道的另一端传来熟悉的气息。他很快就穿过了，来到了尽头。当他这样做的时候，他彻底惊呆了，呆呆地站在那里，心跳加速。他兴奋极了，因为在他的面前，是一座巨大的药草园，里面长满了各种珍稀灵药！
这里的灵草大多都是辅助草药，显然生长时间并不长。旁边还有一些比较昂贵的药材，准确的说，是炼制真元丹、白玉丹或者类似的上品灵级丹所需要的药材。上面至少有十棵金灵树和千脉树，果实都已经成熟了。不过，陆家似乎不太愿意挑选他们。
“诸位，这不是五行莲吗？炼制五行真元丹的主药！”
沉翔惊呼一声，只见药草园中央有一朵莲花，有五片花瓣，每片花瓣的颜色都不同。这就是五行莲，又名五彩莲。
“我靠！这不是九阳炎树吗？”
content_en:
Chen Xiang did not kill these people, otherwise it would alarm other people hiding elsewhere. The entire Lu family will be alarmed by then. The purpose of his coming here this time is to empty their pockets.
He was convinced that the reason why the Lu family was able to join the Demonic Dao Sect was because they had good resources. At the same time, the Lu family also wants to learn magic skills in order to become more powerful.
Magic skills can allow people to quickly improve their strength and master stronger power in a short period of time. However, this is obtained through very cruel means. Some magic skills require drinking human blood, eating human hearts, flesh, etc. Only in this way can it be cultivated. Generally speaking, in this cultivation process, ordinary civilians are the first to bear the brunt, so demonic ways are not tolerated by the public.
Once the medicinal materials that the Lu family is proud of are exhausted...or 'lost', then the Lu family will be abandoned by the Demonic Dao Sect. When the time comes, their collusion with the Demonic Dao Sect will be exposed, and the entire Lu family will be destroyed without Chen Xiang's personal action.
Chen Xiang lurked in the grass around the giant mountain and finally found a large number of people at the foot of the mountain. There were even two warriors at the second level of the True Martial Realm. Among these families, there are not many warriors in the True Martial Realm, but there are two people stationed here. Obviously, they were guarding something important.
Chen Xiang confirmed that the entrance to the herb garden was very close.
"If it were the herb garden you encountered before, the Lu family probably wouldn't have a way to enter the herb garden from the real entrance! If this was the real entrance, they wouldn't need to station so many people here. This entrance is probably an artificial entrance that bypasses the real entrance."
Su Meiyao said.
Chen Xiang nodded and continued to look for the real entrance, because the key was still in his hand. Not sure if it will work, but it never hurts to give it a try.
Chen Xiang looked at a cave with a stone door inside. There are many guards nearby and in the cave. Although not very strong, everyone is very vigilant.
If Chen Xiang cannot find the real entrance, he can only enter through this heavily guarded entrance. When he has to take action, it will inevitably alarm the rest of the Lu family.
After walking around halfway up the mountain, Chen Xiang found a place with few guards. Occasionally there are only one or two people patrolling.
"It should be right here!"
Chen Xiang looked at a cave blocked by many boulders. He immediately walked over and used his spiritual mind to investigate.
"There's a damn door in there!"
Chen Xiang said excitedly, and then gently patted a boulder with his palm. Suddenly, the boulder turned into powder and was blown away by the wind.
This is the [Bone Transforming Demonic Palm]. With a gentle press, the hard boulder turned into extremely fine powder.
Chen Xiang continued to slap several palms one after another. He dug a hole close to the ground, big enough for him to crawl into. After climbing in, he covered the entrance with nearby weeds to avoid being discovered by patrolling guards.
Chen Xiang came to a dark cave. As he walked deeper into the cave, he took out a shiny stone, which illuminated the surrounding environment. Soon, he encountered an iron door.
This gave Chen Xiang a very familiar feeling, because it was the same door as the herb garden he discovered before. He took out the key and inserted it into a small opening on the iron door. As he turned, the iron door gradually opened, but only slowly because Chen Xiang used all his strength to hold down the iron door to prevent it from being damaged. The door causes any sounds or violent vibrations.
As the iron door opened, what Chen Xiang saw was not the herb garden as he imagined, but a passage that appeared in front of him, and a familiar scent came from the other end of the passage. He crossed quickly and came to the end. When he did, he stood there stunned, completely stunned, with his heart racing. He was very excited, because in front of him was a huge herb garden, full of all kinds of rare elixirs!
Here'sMost spiritual herbs are auxiliary herbs and obviously do not take long to grow. There are also some relatively expensive medicinal materials nearby. To be precise, they are the medicinal materials needed to refine the True Yuan Pill, the White Jade Pill, or similar high-grade spiritual pills. There are at least ten golden spirit trees and thousand-veined trees on it, and their fruits are all ripe. However, the Lu family seemed reluctant to choose them.
"Everyone, isn't this the Five Elements Lotus? The main medicine for refining the Five Elements True Essence Pill!"
Chen Xiang exclaimed and saw a lotus flower in the center of the herb garden, with five petals, each petal having a different color. This is the Five Elements Lotus, also known as the Five Color Lotus.
"Holy crap! Isn't this the Nine Sun Flame Tree?"
